s-1.ptxt: Install Throttle Body Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the intake manifold.
Install the connector bracket and throttle body assembly with the 4 bolts.
Connect the 2 water bypass hoses.
Connect the wire harness clamp and throttle body connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Air Cleaner Cap w/ Air Cleaner Hose

s2.ptxt: Install the hinge portion first, and then install the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose with the 3 clamps.
Install the clamp hose band. (*1)
Connect ventilation hose No.2. (*2)
Connect the air flow meter connector. (*3)

s-1.ptxt: Add Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

s2.ptxt: Close the radiator drain cock plug.
Close the cylinder block drain cock plug.
Fill coolant of the specified concentration up to the B line of the radiator reserve tank.

atten3.ptxt: Do not add water as coolant

atten4.ptxt: Squeeze radiator hose NO.1 and radiator hose NO.2 by hand several times, and if the coolant level in the filler drops, add more coolant.

s2.ptxt: After installing the reservoir tank cap, warm up the engine until the thermostat opens. (A)

item.ptxt: Squeeze radiator hose NO.1 and radiator hose NO.2 several times while warming up the engine.
The valve opening timing can be checked by gripping radiator hose NO.2 by hand.
Be careful of cooling fan operation
The engine and radiator become hot, so avoid the risk of burns.

s2.ptxt: After warm-up, repeat the cycle of 3000rpm engine speed for 5 seconds ←→ idling for 45 seconds 8 times or more (7 minutes or more). (B)
Stop the engine and wait until the coolant cools down, and if the level is below LOW, add coolant of the specified concentration through the filler again and adjust it to between FULL and LOW. (C)
Repeat steps (A) to (C) until the coolant level in the radiator reservoir tank stops dropping.
When the level stops dropping, add coolant of the specified concentration through the filler again to adjust the coolant level in the radiator reservoir tank to between FULL and LOW.

s-1.ptxt: Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant) Leak Inspection

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the reservoir tank cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

s2.ptxt: Fill the radiator with coolant and install a radiator cap tester.
Warm up the engine.
118kPa{1.2kgf/cm2Pump it to } and check that the pressure does not drop.

atten4.ptxt: If the pressure drops, check the hoses, radiator and water pump for leaks. If there are no external leaks, check the heater core, cylinder block and cylinder head.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Stop the windshield wiper motor assembly at the automatic stop position.
Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly LH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly RH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s2.ptxt: Operate the front wipers while spraying water or washer fluid on the glass, and check the wiping condition of the blades and that they do not interfere with the body.

s-1.ptxt: Setting Procedure When Disconnecting/Reconnecting Battery Terminal
Inspect Throttle Body Function

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to perform a function inspection after assembling the throttle body or removing and installing its components.

s2.ptxt: Remove the EFI fuse and ETCS fuse at the same time, and connect the fuses after 60 seconds or more have elapsed.
After installing the throttle body to the vehicle, turn the IG ON without operating the accelerator pedal.

atten3.ptxt: If the accelerator pedal is operated, start over from removal of the EFI fuse and ETCS fuse above.

s2.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3 and clear the DTCs.
Start the engine, and check that the check engine warning light is not illuminated and that the idle speed is within the standard when the A/C is turned ON → OFF after warm-up.

item.ptxt: Perform in the N or P position.

s2.ptxt: When the accelerator pedal is quickly depressed to near full open, check that the value of [ECU Data Monitor] - [Throttle Sensor No.1 Opening (THP1)] is 60% or more.
Perform a road test and check that there is nothing unusual.
